title: The Ninefold Tide
pilot_name: The Ninth Bell — bridge rescue proof

target.codec: H.264 high-quality master plus preserved lossless image-sequence source
target.mode: full-quality first proof, not a low-resolution demo
target.animation_timing: 24-fps export; hand-drawn on ones for contacts/fast action and controlled twos where artistically appropriate
target.audio: 48 kHz, dialogue-forward mix; approved natural actor performances

tooling.offline_voice_auditions: Piper TTS; audition only, not automatic approval

policy: No automated shot choice, replacement, unsupervised edit, or publication. Rendering only a manually selected, reviewed and explicitly approved timeline.

principles: Five-view consistent model sheets for all speaking actors
Studio-clean hand-drawn linework and corrected anatomy
Expressive frame-by-frame action at critical moments
3D depth and camera layout for bridge, ferry, stair and rooftop
Physically convincing rope path, tension, hook contact and recoil
Painted multi-plane backgrounds and consistent perspective
Natural distinct age-appropriate approved voice takes
Reviewed phoneme mouth cues and emotional acting, including blinks and breaths
Original sound effects, believable ambience and professional dialogue-forward mix
No unapproved assets/music/voices and no shot replacements
True 1920x1080, 24 fps deliverable with separately verified final mix
Director's complete visual/audio review before claiming quality acceptance

software_availability_policy: Install and verify the whole free toolchain before first visual production proof; assign only the specialist tools needed to each shot, but do not lower artistic standard.
